subject: Request: permission to use customer quote + logo placement for Kestrel Health spotlight
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa.moreno@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: permission to use customer quote + logo placement for Kestrel Health spotlight

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the great demo last month — the Kestrel team’s metrics and engineering story are exactly the kind of material our customers respond to. We put together a short customer spotlight draft (one-paragraph quote + two-line byline) and a small badge mockup for placement on our marketing site and a tweet.

Could you confirm whether Kestrel is comfortable with the excerpt below and the attached mockup? If legal needs to review, please loop them in — we’re happy to adjust language to avoid any endorsement implications.

Draft quote (for review):
"Redwood Inference reduced our inference latency by 3x and cut per-token inference cost by ~40% across critical pipelines, enabling faster, cheaper ML-driven features for our clinicians."

Proposed byline: Alyssa Moreno, VP Product, Kestrel Health

Attachments: draft-quote-kestrel.txt (text/plain), kestrel-badge-mockup_v1.png (image/png)

If this is OK, we’ll send a short permission PDF for signature and a final creative for your internal comms sign-off. Target publish window: mid-June.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0174
From: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa.moreno@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: permission to use customer quote + logo placement for Kestrel Health spotlight

Hi Sean — thanks, this looks promising. I’ve forwarded to our legal team (Jordan) to confirm the precise wording and logo usage. A couple quick notes from product/brand: please use the horizontal logo (no tagline) and avoid implying our endorsement of specific medical outcomes.

Also attaching our brand guidelines so you can confirm spacing/clearspace rules. Jordan — looping you in to take a look and advise on the permission language and whether a signed release is required.

Attachments: brand-guidelines-kestrel.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Moreno | VP Product | Kestrel Health
alyssa.moreno@kestrelhealth.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@kestrelhealth.com>, Alyssa Moreno <alyssa.moreno@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:45:30 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: permission to use customer quote + logo placement for Kestrel Health spotlight

Hi all — thanks for the loop. I reviewed the draft quote and the mockup. For marketing collateral we usually request two small edits to avoid implying clinical endorsement:

1) Replace the phrase "enabling faster, cheaper ML-driven features for our clinicians" with "enabling faster, more cost-efficient ML-driven features".
2) Add the following sentence to the permissions clause: "Kestrel Health grants Redwood Inference a non-exclusive, royalty-free right to use the approved quote and logo in marketing materials, subject to Kestrel’s brand guidelines."

I attached a redlined version of the one-pager with the suggested text change and a short permission template. Happy to take a quick call if helpful.

Attachments: quote-redline-kestrel.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa.moreno@kestrelhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 12:20:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: permission to use customer quote + logo placement for Kestrel Health spotlight

Kimberly — thanks for the careful review. We agree with the suggested edit to the quote language and the permissions clause as drafted. I’ve uploaded a signed permission PDF and initiated a DocuSign envelope for Alyssa to sign on behalf of Kestrel. The DocuSign link is below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcdef123456
Attachments: kestrel_permission_signed.pdf (application/pdf)

Alyssa will complete the signature, but Jordan (legal) has pre-approved the final language. Please confirm receipt and expected publish timing.

Best,
Jordan Price | Sr. Counsel, Kestrel Health
jordan.price@kestrelhealth.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa.moreno@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: permission to use customer quote + logo placement for Kestrel Health spotlight

Thanks everyone — received the signed doc and the DocuSign completion notice (Jordan, appreciate you moving quickly). Alyssa — once you finalize the quick signature, we’ll proceed with the following:

- Finalize creative with Marissa’s design team (using horizontal logo; clearspace per your guidelines).
- Production QA: accessibility check + shortened alt text for badge.
- Publish to customer success case studies page and schedule a short LinkedIn post.
- We’ll add a HubSpot activity (linked) and tag KST-4532 for tracking.

Final assets I’ll upload to the shared drive and share a review link by EOD Wednesday. Thanks again — excited to feature Kestrel’s work.

Sean
